toolCallDetails.arguments: {"path":"snake_openai-gpt-6-sol_01.html","edit_description":"Create a complete standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript Snake game, no dependencies, using a real 30×30 canvas grid. Give it a polished modern dark arcade visual treatment (warm off-white typography, vibrant lime and coral snake colors, dark navy board, restrained grid, glowing food, top logo/heading, score cards, responsive layout, menu overlay and game-over overlay, readable keyboard instructions). Three selectable match cards in the start menu: HUMAN vs HUMAN, CPU vs HUMAN, CPU vs CPU. Player 1 uses WASD and player 2 uses arrow keys; in CPU vs HUMAN, CPU is player 1 and human is player 2, and UI should make that clear. Continuous interval movement; single food randomly spawns on free cells and causes snake to grow, score increments. For each tick choose CPU moves by BFS shortest-path to food considering occupied cells and not reversing, with safe fallback that estimates available open area (flood fill) and avoids immediate collision; two CPUs choose independently each tick. Start opposite sides heading inward; handle direction change max once per tick to prevent instant reversal. Simultaneously compute heads, food growth and wall/body collisions for both snakes, including other snake, tail moving away, head-on and crossing-head swap; game ends if one or both snakes crash, appropriate winner/draw messaging. Victory if board fills. Start button/card selection, overlay with keyboard shortcuts (1/2/3 choose and start mode; Enter start selected mode, space to restart after end; Escape from gameplay returns menu; R restart anytime after game has started), pause via P with visible pause overlay optional. Game over overlay clearly shows scores, winner and controls for rematch or menu. Maintain crisp canvas drawing with devicePixelRatio scaling and resize responsiveness, avoid losing game state on resize; full accessible buttons and aria labels, no external resources. Keep code clear with named functions and comments where necessary. Make sure all HTML, CSS, JS in this ONE file, filename as given."}
